title: Nnamdi Madubuike doing "more and more," but Ravens uncertain about Week 1

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Nnamdi Madubuike doing "more and more," but Ravens uncertain about Week 1
sources.description: Ravens defensive tackle Nnamdi Madubuike did not go on injured reserve while the team set its initial 53-man roster, which means that the team does not think he will miss the first four games of the season as he continues working his way back from the neck injury that kept him out for most of last year.
